context_for_next_testing_agent: For fast auth: GET /api/csrf-token -> POST /api/user/login with x-csrf-token header. JWT is at response.data.accessToken (NOT response.data as a string). Inject via add_init_script: localStorage.setItem('token', <jwt>) before navigating. Set lang='en' + lang_manual='true'. Desktop sidebar mounts only >=1200px; mobile nav below 1200px. For Playwright locators, prefer page.get_by_text(label, exact=True) rather than JS document.querySelector .click() because sidebar items use React onClick handlers that require synthetic events.
